privatedomains-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in tafatirka lagu xaddido isticmaalayaasha leh cinwaan iimayl gaar ah
privatedomains-nomanageaccess:
Ma haysatid xuquuq ku filan oo aad ku maamusho domain-yada gaarka ah ee la oggol yahay ee wiki-kan.
Kaliya xafiiyada ee wiki-ga iyo xubnaha shaqaalaha ayaa heli kara.

Haddii aadan gelin akoonkaaga, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad [[Special:UserLogin|gasho]].
privatedomains-ifemailcontact: Haddii kale, fadlan la xiriir [[Special:EmailUser/$1|$1]] haddii aad qabto wax su'aalo ah.
saveprivatedomains-success: Isbeddellada domain-yada gaarka ah waa la kaydiyay.
privatedomains-invalidemail:
Waan ka xunnahay, gelitaanka wiki-kan waxaa loo xaddiday xubnaha $1 oo keliya.
Haddii aad leedahay cinwaan iimayl oo la xiriira $1, waxaad geli kartaa ama dib u xaqiijin kartaa cinwaankaaga iimaylka adigoo adeegsanaya [[Special:Preferences|bogga dookhyada akoonkaaga]].
Weli waad arki kartaa bogagga wiki-kan, laakiin ma awoodi doontid inaad wax ka beddesho.
privatedomains-emailadminlabel: Magaca isticmaalaha lala xiriirayo haddii ay jiraan dhibaatooyin gelitaan ama su'aalo:
